altTextRequired: Every image here needs alt text. Add it in the media library, then save again. Missing for: {{ titles }}
anchorIdHelp: Optional. Lets links jump to this section, e.g. "services" for #services.
downloadsWidgetDescription: List of files to download, by tag or picked by hand.
emptyListing: Nothing to show yet: no published records match this section. Visitors do not see this section.
emptyPick: No published records picked yet. Visitors do not see this section.
emptyProductCategory: No published products to show. Choose a category page, or place this section on a product category page. Visitors do not see this section.
featureGridDescription: Section of short titled items, e.g. services or values.
fileTagsHelp: Lists the files that have any of these tags, in alphabetical order.
galleryImagesHelp: In the order shown. Every image needs alt text. Square crops are shown; at least 1600 px wide.
galleryWidgetDescription: Grid of images that open larger in a viewer.
itemAnchorHelp: Optional. Lets links jump to this item.
itemImageHelp: Optional. Ratio 4:3, at least 1200 px wide. The image needs alt text.
locationsWidgetDescription: Offices and sites: all, of one organization, or picked by hand.
organizationsWidgetDescription: Group organizations: all, or picked by hand.
peopleWidgetDescription: Profiles: picked by hand, or of one organization. Never shows contact details.
pickHelp: In the order shown. Only published records appear on the website.
productCategoryHelp: Leave empty on a product category page to list its own products.
productListDescription: Products of a category page, or picked by hand.
showAddressHelp: City and country are always shown. Phone and email appear only for locations that allow it.
statNoteHelp: Optional source or "as of" date, e.g. "As of June 2026".
statValueHelp: Text, so "1,700+" or "$67 Mn" both work. Up to 20 characters.
statsDescription: Up to six key figures with labels.
statsItemsHelp: Publish only figures the owner has confirmed, with an "as of" date in the note.
